title: Fit a Gas Harvester I at Node Beta: the tool of the gas test
note: A plain miner (a mining laser, no ice harvester) docks at Node Beta, buys one Gas Harvester I (1,202 x 18 at the best price, 20:45 UTC; the limit here is 1,300 cr) and fits it beside the mining laser (catalog: cpu 4, power 6; a starter has 2 utility slots). One pilot only: the test of mine-gsc-0050-gas-plume (orders.log ENT-007, block ZERO: plasma gas next). Written by Zero 2026-11-15.
